description.text: AI-written synthesis of the program page, prepared by the collecting assistant: Creative Destruction Lab says it is a nonprofit that delivers an objectives-based program for massively scalable, seed-stage, science- and technology-based companies. It says mentorship comes from Fellows and Associates, that intensive full-day sessions happen every eight weeks to assess progress and set short-term objectives, and that chief scientists advise on technology roadmaps while business school students help with models, markets, and scaling strategy. The page lists many streams in the navigation, including Prime, AgriFood, Artificial Intelligence, and others. Those stream pages were not opened. No investment amount or deadline was in the program text that was kept.

targetApplicants.text: AI-written interpretation of the program page, prepared by the collecting assistant: the page says the program is designed for early-stage, science-based technology companies, and that all applicants are considered based on potential to scale and product viability. It says the objective-setting process is aimed at technical founders learning from experienced entrepreneurs. That is a narrative description, not a closed stage enum.

sources.title: Creative Destruction Lab program page — Format and who it is for
sources.quote:
Creative Destruction Lab (CDL) is a nonprofit organization that delivers an objectives-based program for massively scalable, seed-stage, science- and technology-based companies.

Intensive full-day sessions with the CDL Mentors take place every eight weeks with the purpose of assessing progress and setting new short-term objectives.

The program is designed for early-stage, science-based technology companies, though we consider all applicants based on their potential to scale and the viability of their product.

limitations: The application questions were not opened. No account was created, no terms were accepted, and nothing was submitted. Fields stay empty and Start Application stays blocked.
Stream pages linked from the navigation were not opened. No deadline was published in the program text that was kept.
